transcript.text: I need to flag a critical logistics issue: the next fuel delivery won't arrive until 2200 tomorrow, not tomorrow morning. This means we must preserve 500 liters as our end-of-day generator reserve instead of the routine 300 liters. With 1,200 liters on hand right now, that leaves us only 700 liters available for tomorrow's generator operations. The carrier delay is in the logistics tracker but hasn't made it to the fuel-control slide yet, so Col. Mercer's plan may be built on the old 300-liter reserve assumption.
